rig.reconstruction_note: Each decisive pose stores a complete generic biped joint layout as root-relative ASCII controls. The body and task are independent authored abstraction; no source silhouette or choreography is reproduced.

compile.connector: deterministic eased joint interpolation only between authored keys; support/contact semantics change only at authored key boundaries

keys.label: OFFSET_REAR_LOAD
keys.causal_role: rear-biased asymmetric load stores forward travel while the striking side stays withheld
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root sinks over rear-right support; chest coils left while lead shoulder/hand stay behind the intended aerial task

keys.label: DIAGONAL_SUPPORT_BREAK
keys.causal_role: rear support releases into an oblique launch whose forward debt is already committed
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root jumps up-right; torso uncoils only partly so task preparation survives support loss

keys.label: RISING_TASK_CHAMBER
keys.causal_role: the airborne task chambers across the body while the root keeps one ballistic arc
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root climbs forward; striking-side elbow folds across chest while opposite arm counterbalances

keys.label: CROSSBODY_COMMIT
keys.causal_role: task commitment spends torso rotation and limb reach without inventing a root impulse
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root still rises but less; striking hand cuts across/forward as chest rotates opposite the trailing leg

keys.label: WHIFF_APEX_OVERRUN
keys.causal_role: the task misses; absent contact force means follow-through must continue instead of recoiling
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root reaches a brief apex with forward drift; chest and striking arm overrun the target line while hips lag

keys.label: FOLLOWTHROUGH_DROP
keys.causal_role: gravity begins descent while the missed task keeps the torso ahead of the pelvis
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root descends/right; striking arm wraps down past center, opposite arm remains high and late

keys.label: LATE_RETRACT_DESCENT
keys.causal_role: limbs retract late, spending the remaining rotation to prepare a survivable landing
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root drops faster with forward travel; lead leg starts to reach down while striking shoulder remains ahead

keys.label: WRONG_FOOT_PRECONTACT
keys.causal_role: the body cannot square in time; the rear/right foot becomes the only reachable first support
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root continues down/right; right heel drops under a still-forward chest while left leg remains long and late

keys.label: REAR_HEEL_CONTACT
keys.causal_role: wrong-foot first contact acquires support but cannot arrest the forward chest or remaining vertical debt
keys.motion_arc_root_note: right heel catches while root still descends/advances; torso stays ahead and left foot is still searching

keys.label: LEAD_FOOT_SLAP_TRANSFER
keys.causal_role: late left foot slaps down to widen the base while root continues forward into compression
keys.motion_arc_root_note: support broadens asymmetrically; left foot lands ahead as chest overshoots both contacts

keys.label: TWISTED_BRAKE_CRUSH
keys.causal_role: deep unequal compression finally pays vertical and whiff-rotation debt rather than resetting to neutral
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root reaches lowest grounded point; knees compress unequally, chest countertwists, strike-side arm hangs late

keys.label: UNWIND_REBOUND_LAG
keys.causal_role: ground reaction rebounds the root while the strike-side shoulder/hand remain visibly late
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root rises slightly at a new address; torso unwinds opposite compression and right hand trails below

keys.label: DISPLACED_GUARD_EXIT
keys.causal_role: readiness returns displaced with residual asymmetry and a guarded task side rather than an idle reset
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root settles farther forward; torso retains a slight counter-cant and arms finish unequal

rounds.inspection: The support break reads earned from the rear load; the airborne task chambers before the cross-body commitment; the whiff apex visibly overruns rather than rebounding; descent continues on one root arc; right-foot precontact and first heel support precede the late left-foot slap; the root keeps moving down/forward into a deep twisted two-foot crush; rebound rises at a displaced address with the task-side hand late; exit stays asymmetric instead of returning to idle.

noodle_queen.taste: PASS — the chamber → whiff overrun → wrong-foot heel catch → twisted crush is a memorable silhouette chain rather than a generic jump.
noodle_queen.function: PASS — the absence of task contact has a causal consequence: follow-through persists, landing orientation worsens, support transfers, compression pays vertical/rotation debt, and rebound/exit remain displaced.
noodle_queen.contempt: PASS — no hover, magical task recoil, endpoint morph, symmetric landing, reverse-play recovery, or polite idle reset survives.
